description: ELM filter summary and RDE-2 architecture figure
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
elm=pd.read_csv("elm_Q19672.tsv",sep="\t")
print("total ELM raw hits:",len(elm))
print("is_annotated True:", elm.is_annotated.sum(), " surviving all filters (no filter flags True):",
      (~(elm[['is_phiblastmatch','is_filtered','phiblast','topodomfilter','taxonfilter','structure']].any(axis=1))).sum())
print(elm.elm_identifier.str.split("_").str[0].value_counts())
print("\nAny RNA-binding-related ELM class?", [c for c in elm.elm_identifier.unique() if any(k in c.upper() for k in ["RNA","RRM","RGG","PUM","SM_"])])
# hits inside the N-PLD and the acidic IDRs
for lab,(a,b) in {"N-PLD 1-45":(1,45),"IDR 216-294":(216,294),"IDR 297-350":(297,350)}.items():
    sub=elm[(elm.start>=a)&(elm.stop<=b)]
    print(f"\n{lab}: {len(sub)} raw hits; annotated={sub.is_annotated.sum()}")
    print("   ", sorted(sub.elm_identifier.unique()))

# summary figure: RDE-2 domain architecture
seq=open("rde2_Q19672.fasta").read().split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
pl=np.load("plddt.npy"); L=len(seq)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.4))
ax.plot(range(1,L+1), pl, color="#4a5568", lw=1)
ax.axhline(70, ls="--", color="grey", lw=.8)
bands=[(1,45,"#d69e2e","N-terminal prion-like domain\nY 15.6%, Q+N 26.7%, 0 charged residues\n(MUT-16-binding, cation-pi)"),
       (46,215,"#4299e1","folded core (OB/beta-rich)"),
       (216,294,"#9f7aea","acidic IDR  NCPR -0.13"),
       (297,350,"#9f7aea","acidic IDR  NCPR -0.13"),
       (351,578,"#4299e1","folded core (MUT-7-proximal)")]
for a,b,c,lab in bands:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=.28)
ax.text(23,104,"PLD",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#975a16",weight="bold")
ax.text(255,104,"acidic IDRs",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#553c9a",weight="bold")
ax.text(130,104,"folded",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#2b6cb0")
ax.text(465,104,"folded",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#2b6cb0")
ax.set_ylim(0,115); ax.set_xlim(1,L)
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_title("RDE-2/MUT-8 (Q19672): no RGG/RG box, no K/R patch, net charge -18; aromatics confined to the N-terminal PLD")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
